how: each seed is a one-line sed of the staged script into /tmp/tmparw-mut/<seed>.sh; TMPAR_SH=<that copy> python3 -I <the test>; logs seed-<seed>.log

seeds.seed: m1-no-align: the helper's copies are not used (mp=($mp) instead of mp=($la))
seeds.behaviour: the parts go to trust_mutants --merge through tm-lock-align.py
failing_tests: (b) the merged line names the aligned copies

seeds.seed: m2-no-pathcheck: any helper output is taken (lok=1, no count or path check)
seeds.behaviour: a helper failure or a path that is not the part or its $T/norm copy: the parts as they are
seeds.old: lok=1; (( ${#la} == N )) || lok=""; [ -n "$lok" ] && for k in {1..$N}; do [[ ${la[$k]} == (${mp[$k]}|$T/norm/part-$k.norm.json) ]] || lok=""; done

seeds.seed: m3-no-keep-err: a refused merge does not keep lockalign.err
seeds.behaviour: a refused merge keeps lockalign.err with its inputs
failing_tests: (c) no aligned copy went to the merge: the kept inputs ... + lockalign.err

seeds.seed: m4-no-note: the merged line does not name the aligned copies
seeds.behaviour: the merged line in cloud-overflow.log names the aligned copies
failing_tests: (b) the merged line names the aligned copies
